wgpu output ke copy chhara Flutter Texture e dekhano (iOS IOSurface/CVPixelBuffer, Android HardwareBuffer)

notes.text: iOS part works on the simulator (branch p1-001-ios-texture-spike, SPIKE, off main): IOSurface CVPixelBuffer as FlutterTexture + MTLTexture on the same IOSurface, wgpu draws via wgpu-hal, no CPU copy. Pending: real iPhone, Android HardwareBuffer path, an IOSurface-backed host test. Known spike limits: single frame (continuous preview needs double buffering or MTLSharedEvent sync), textures never unregistered.

blocked: Android half (HardwareBuffer/SurfaceProducer) needs an Android emulator or device and more free disk (~2.8 GB free). iOS half works on the simulator on branch p1-001-ios-texture-spike (SPIKE, off main).
iOS zero-copy confirmed on the host too: engine/render/tests/iosurface_wrap.rs (IOSurface-backed texture, pixels read from the IOSurface). Remaining: Android half, real iPhone check.

Android half works on the arm64 API 36 emulator: SurfaceProducer Surface -> JNI -> ANativeWindow -> wgpu (Vulkan) surface, Flutter Impeller (GLES) shows it, no CPU copy. Android clippy -D warnings clean (aarch64/x86_64). Unverified: real iPhone, real Android phone; the frame survives the swapchain drop after present only by observation, so P1-005 must keep the surface alive while the producer lives.

notes.text: From the P1-001 spike: move rendering off the UI isolate to the render thread with a fence (spike blocks the UI isolate in engine_spike_render_metal); move ENGINE_ERR_GPU next to the other error codes; replace the method channel with C ABI callbacks.

Unblocked: user had the P1-001 spike (render crate, iOS + Android preview) merged into main on 2026-10-18. Spike code is still marked // SPIKE; P1-005 replaces it.

tasks.title: dart:ffi command-event API (engine_create with protocol version, engine_send, engine_set_event_callback, engine_destroy)

notes.text: plan: proto/framix/v1/engine.proto (Command: AddTrack, InsertClip, Undo, Redo; Event: TimelineChanged, CommandFailed; times in ticks). Rust: app builds proto via prost-build + protox (no protoc in Xcode/Gradle builds); app::engine::Engine::handle(Command)->Event over History. ffi: ENGINE_PROTOCOL_VERSION=1, engine_create(version, out)->code, engine_send copies bytes to an engine thread (mpsc), engine_set_event_callback(fn(ptr,len)) (Dart frees via engine_free_buffer), engine_destroy joins the thread. Dart: protoc_plugin 25.1.0 -> lib/core/engine/proto, FramixEngine (NativeCallable.listener, events stream). First command set is included because the API can't be tested without commands.
new deps need user sign-off: prost, prost-build, protox (build-time, ~40 crates), Dart protobuf, fixnum, ffi
